articleTitle: Brevo Homepage Teardown: Jan 2023 to Jun 2026
h1: How Brevo rewrote its homepage over 3 years

analysis-blocks.label: Jan 2023 — original state
analysis-blocks.heading: The original: growth-outcome messaging
annotations: H1 opens with: "Connections that spark growth" — accessible benefit language aimed at a broad audience.
Visible section headings include: "Wide reachClose connection", "Everyone can grow with Brevo".
Section headings later removed include: "Wide reachClose connection" and "Everyone can grow with Brevo".

analysis-blocks.label: Jun 2026 — current state
analysis-blocks.heading: Today: updated positioning
annotations: H1 now reads: "Turn Every EmailSMSOrder Interaction into a Lifetime Customer" — updated value proposition.
New section headings include: "Join 600,000+ customers around the world who trust Brevo", "Engage your audience your way", "AI agents that work with you, and for you".
Third-party validation visible in section headings: "Awarded for excellence".
CTAs no longer present include: "Get Brevo", "Read customer stories", "See all integrations".

messaging.after: Turn Every EmailSMSOrderInteraction into a Lifetime Customer
messaging.note: This change can be read as a deliberate update to the primary value proposition frame. No confirmed strategy is implied.

messaging.before: Brevo helps you grow your business. Build customer relationships across email, SMS, chat, and more. Use the tools you need, when you need them. Try it for free.
messaging.after: Brevo is the most intuitive all-in-one customer engagement platform: email and SMS marketing, automation, CRM, live chat, and transactional email. Try it free.
messaging.note: The new description is shorter and more neutral in tone. Whether this is intentional de-emphasis or a simplification pass is not determinable from text alone.

messaging.after: Brevo: Email & SMS Marketing, CRM & Automation Platform
